author: bardic-inspiration
name: Gatehouse Watch
summary: A deathbound zealot and four cultists guard the gate of Testmore Keep.

parts.text: A guttering brazier lights the space under the half-raised portcullis. A scarred figure in a stained tabard stands perfectly still in the middle of it, while hooded cultists dice on an upturned shield.

The {ref:creature/deathbound-zealot} fights to the death and never retreats past the portcullis. The {ref:creature/cultist}s shout a warning toward the Ritual Chamber on the first round, then flee once the zealot falls.
